  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.canonical_venue,
  p.venue,
  p.venue_type,
  p.year,
  p.citation_count
FROM Papers p
JOIN PaperAuthors pa ON p.corpus_id = pa.corpus_id
JOIN Authors a ON pa.author_id = a.author_id
WHERE p.year = 2016
  AND p.canonical_venue ILIKE '%CHI%'
  AND (p.venue ILIKE '%ACM%' OR p.venue ILIKE '%SIGCHI%' OR p.venue ILIKE '%human factors in computing systems%')
  AND a.name ILIKE '%teresa almeida%'
  AND p.title ILIKE '%on looking at the vagina through labella%'
ORDER BY p.citation_count DESC, p.year DESC
LIMIT 100

sql:
SELECT corpus_id, title, abstract, canonical_venue, venue_type, year, citation_count
FROM Papers
WHERE canonical_venue ILIKE '%ACL%'
  AND year = 2019
  AND (
    title ILIKE '%learning%'
    AND title ILIKE '%transferable%'
    AND title ILIKE '%feature%'
    AND title ILIKE '%representation%'
    AND title ILIKE '%neural%'
  )
ORDER BY citation_count DESC, year DESC
LIMIT 100
